subject.title: [Feature]: Surface watched-session awareness to the model (prompt section, corrected tool blurbs, durable notices)

question: Should the main agent receive a dynamic prompt section enumerating watched group/topic sessions, or should core stop at accurate generic tool guidance plus the existing durable `stateVersion`/`changesSince` reconciliation path?
rationale: Both paths preserve the established visibility boundary, but naming watched sessions in every prompt changes model-visible metadata and prompt-cache behavior in a way source inspection cannot choose safely.

options.title: Guidance-first repair
options.body: Correct the session tool summaries and add a bounded recall instruction, while relying on existing state versions and `changesSince` for durable reconciliation.

options.title: Enumerate watched sessions
options.body: Add a dynamic, privacy-reviewed prompt section with watched session titles and freshness metadata, plus cache and visibility regression coverage.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Retain notices and tool access without further model guidance, accepting that the documented capability remains less discoverable.

recommendation.title: Guidance-first repair
recommendation.body: Correct the session tool summaries and add a bounded recall instruction, while relying on existing state versions and `changesSince` for durable reconciliation.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged ambient-watch and provenance work makes this the clearest available owner for the prompt-versus-durable-context product boundary.
